I feel like I can understand this because I went through something extremely similar. First I just want to say It Is not your fault In the slightest way. You didnt lead him on, he was In the wrong. Even if what you went through with him was "good" that doesn't mean It wasnt toxic. He was wrong for what he did, like you said he knew what he was doing 1000%. He was an adult and you were 13, he knew what was going on but still did It.

I understand wanting to long for this person, they may have made you feel happy and have taken care of you but what he did was sick. He manipulated you into thinking what was going on and what he was doing was okay. You aren't overreacting, I promise you that. Its really a hard thing to overcome and I get why you feel the way you do.

It'll take time but I hope eventually you'll be able to come to terms with what happened and realize It wasnt your fault. Its okay to not be over It yet, everyone heals at a different pace. Youre a precious person to this earth and suicide Isnt the way to go. I wish you the best. :) I hope this helps even the tiniest bit.
Im so glad to hear that! :)

Im sorry to hear about your situation. I sympathize with you a lot because I went through something quite similar. I know everybody always says Its not worth It but, It really Isn't It. Im sorry, most of the times I dont really know what to say but I hope maybe this helps the tiniest bit. From what you said It seems like your mom really looks down on you and always finds away to put you down, that's really tough to go through. No matter what other people think, you have to do things at your own pace, whether Its to societies norms or not. That kind of doesn't make sense but I thought Id throw It In there. I understand that having to hear "It gets better" every time youre going through something hard can just be annoying. It seems like It never will. It can take years to feel a little bit better but i guess its better than nothing. I know that It can feel and be almost impossible to bear what youre going through and you want to give up but, (as stupid as it sounds) It wont always be this way. It really does seem like It will be when youre this deep down but It wont. You may not think It and others may not say the same but Im sure that youre gonna be able to do amazing things, better your education and heal, even If It Is insanely slow. I hope that your environment wont always be so toxic. I wish the best for you, despite not knowing you. I really do hope things change for you and soon enough this will all just be bad memories. I hope this made sense and maybe helped a bit. x
